name: chainscope
description: ChainScope — blockchain transaction graph investigation workstation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @chainscope/api" "npm run dev -w @chainscope/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w @chainscope/web && npm run build -w @chainscope/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chainscope/shared && npm run typecheck -w @chainscope/api && npm run typecheck -w @chainscope/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @chainscope/api && npm run test -w @chainscope/web && npm run test:engine
